title: Stage budget (P2.2)
description: Canonical shape of a stage budget as declared in a stage profile (kernel/stages/*.yaml). Mapping to the enforcement vocabulary used by budgets.py, events, and budget.json: hard_limit = usd; soft_limit = soft_usd when present, else 0.8 x usd rounded to cents (a deterministic default so a stage without soft_usd still notifies near its ceiling instead of silently spending to the hard stop). tokens is the attempt context budget and minutes the adapter timeout - caps owned by the engine, not currency.

usd.description: hard_limit: hard budget ceiling in USD for the stage (cumulative across its attempts).

minutes.description: Maximum adapter wall time for one attempt.

soft_usd.description: soft_limit: notify at this point in USD; must be less than usd (doctor checks soft < hard; the runtime never relaxes a limit).
